commit_message: Model runtime: correct deterministic failures before Heavy review

edits.old:
git clone --quiet --single-branch --branch "$RESULT_BRANCH" \
    git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git "$VERIFY_DIR"

  set +e
  python3 -m model_runtime.deterministic_verifier
edits.new:
git clone --quiet --single-branch --branch "$RESULT_BRANCH" \
    git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git "$VERIFY_DIR"

  echo "===== STRICT-TARGET SANITIZER ====="
  python3 -m model_runtime.sanitize_result_branch \
    --repo "$VERIFY_DIR" \
    --base-ref "$VERIFY_BASE_COMMIT" \
    --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
    --output "$SANITIZE_JSON"

  set +e
  python3 -m model_runtime.deterministic_verifier

edits.old:
LAST_VERIFY="$VERIFY_JSON"

  echo
  echo "===== HEAVY REVIEW / 27B / 24K ====="
  python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager prepare heavy

  set +e
  python3 -m model_runtime.heavy_review \
    --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
    --verifier "$VERIFY_JSON" \
    --diff "$DIFF_FILE" \
    --output "$HEAVY_JSON" \
    --endpoint "$LITELLM_URL" \
    --model "$HEAVY_ALIAS"
  HEAVY_RC=$?
  set -e

  LAST_HEAVY="$HEAVY_JSON"
edits.new:
LAST_VERIFY="$VERIFY_JSON"

  if [[ ! -s "$VERIFY_JSON" ]]; then
    echo "FEHLER: Verifier hat keinen Report erzeugt."
    exit 43
  fi

  if [[ $VERIFY_RC -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo
    echo "===== DETERMINISTISCHE KORREKTUR ENTSCHEIDUNG ====="
    echo "[PIPELINE] Verifier hat Blocker gefunden; Heavy Review wird bis nach deren Behebung übersprungen."
    python3 - "$VERIFY_JSON" "$HEAVY_JSON" <<'PY'
import json, sys
verifier_path, output_path = sys.argv[1:]
verifier = json.load(open(verifier_path, encoding='utf-8'))
issues = []
for item in verifier.get('blockers', []):
    code = str(item.get('code', 'BLOCKER'))
    message = str(item.get('message', '')).strip()
    paths = item.get('paths') or []
    path = str(item.get('path', '')).strip()
    if not path and isinstance(paths, list) and paths:
        path = ', '.join(str(p) for p in paths)
    evidence = str(item.get('evidence', '')).strip()
    if not evidence:
        evidence = json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False)
    issues.append({
        'severity': 'blocker',
        'path': path,
        'evidence': f'{code}: {evidence}',
        'required_change': message or f'Blocker {code} beheben.',
    })
result = {
    'schema': 1,
    'verdict': 'corrections',
    'summary': f'Deterministischer Verifier meldet {len(issues)} Blocker.',
    'issues': issues,
    'tests_to_run': verifier.get('acceptance_requirements', {}).get('tests', []),
    'verifier_ok': False,
    '_generated_by': 'deterministic_verifier',
}
open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(
    json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
)
PY
    HEAVY_RC=30
  else
    echo
    echo "===== HEAVY REVIEW / 27B / 24K ====="
    python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager prepare heavy

    set +e
    python3 -m model_runtime.heavy_review \
      --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
      --verifier "$VERIFY_JSON" \
      --diff "$DIFF_FILE" \
      --output "$HEAVY_JSON" \
      --endpoint "$LITELLM_URL" \
      --model "$HEAVY_ALIAS"
    HEAVY_RC=$?
    set -e
  fi

  LAST_HEAVY="$HEAVY_JSON"
